jobs.name: one-knock-five-rooms
jobs.sentence: Feed it sound and threads reach out, branch, and fuse where they meet; the network that grows is the room you hear.
jobs.claim: One knock, sent through one colony as it grows (3, 25, 60, 170 threads, then frosted until no dead ends are left), comes back from a longer room each time, and the frosted dish rings longest. The general claim is the page's (its opening and the frost row of How it grows); the figures are this piece's own, measured on one colony, with the piece check's twelve-colony medians leaking in from Biomechanical Synthesis's workshop for comparison.
chain: hand: Mycelial Reverb plugin engine (Algorithm.h), the project's own instrument, read through rooms.cpp (the bench has no roster line for a project's instrument, so it goes as hand)

jobs.name: one-frost-survey
jobs.sentence: A frost kills every dead end one thread back | The lossy tips go; what is left rings longer
jobs.claim: Not a piece: a check of the table row the piece leans on. Over the piece check's twelve growth seeds, does one frost make a full dish ring longer, or does it take frosting until no dead ends are left?

jobs.name: one-knock-five-rooms-picture
jobs.sentence: Feed it sound and threads reach out, branch, and fuse where they meet; the network that grows is the room you hear.
